predecessors.note: Somaliland took Las Anod in October 2007; the Dhulbahante administration (the SSC of 2009, Khatumo State declared 12 January 2012) did not hold it. 'Somaliland lost control of a significant portion of its eastern territory' in 2023 (somaliland ledger 5).

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no row. After the offensive of 25 August 2023 SSC-Khatumo held 'Las Anod and the wider Sool region'; 'in fall 2023, the front line shifted to western Sool, between Oog and Guumays' (about 100 km west of Las Anod, a stalemate in August 2024), roughly the Isaaq-Dhulbahante clan line. Neither page gives an area. The 120 km disc cut to Somaliland (151 cells, about 38,200 km2; the whole disc is 215 cells) is the somaliland dossier's own region for the loss; the Buuhoodle district of Cayn, held by SSC-aligned forces, is not drawn, nor is the claim to Sanaag (Ceerigaabo is not on the page).

region.text: Las Anod, from which Somaliland troops withdrew to their Sool outposts after the protests of December 2022 to January 2023

ledger.note: 6 February 2023: the Dhulbahante elders announce SSC-Khatumo in Las Anod. 'Dhulbahante clan elders declared their intent to form a state government named SSC-Khatumo' on 6 February 2023 (SSC-Khatumo page: 're-established as SSC-Khaatumo 6 February 2023'); the Las Anod page: mass protests 'from December into January' made Somaliland troops withdraw from the city to their Sool outposts, 'which allowed Garad Jama Garad Ali to return to Las Anod'. Fighting erupted on 6 February.

ledger.note: 6 February 2023: the Las Anod conflict. 'Fighting erupted on 6 February 2023 after Somaliland security forces violently cracked down on civilian protests'; Somaliland forces north of Las Anod began shelling the city at 6 am. Mirrors somaliland ledger 4 (year only).

ledger.note: 25 August 2023: SSC-Khatumo takes the eastern Sool. 'On 25 August 2023, SSC-Khatumo attacked Somaliland positions on the city's outskirts and captured the Maraaga and Goojacade bases'; Somaliland forces 'fled and regrouped at Dhodida'; infobox: 'The Somaliland army withdrew about 100 km west of Las Anod.' Mirrors somaliland ledger 5 (year only, where the pages gave no date).

ledger.note: 28 August 2023: SSC-Khatumo declares a cessation of hostilities, 'citing a strategic withdrawal of forces from Las Anod' (the infobox dates the conflict 6 February to 28 August 2023). Skirmishes continued at Buq-Dharkayn and Yeyle (November 2023) and Qoorlugud (31 October and 1 November 2024) without moving the line.

30 July 2025: Khatumo is reconstituted as the North Eastern State of Somalia. 'Delegates in Las Anod announced the reconstitution of Khatumo as the North Eastern State'; a federal member state of Somalia (the Federal Government recognised the interim administration on 19 October 2023); an 83-member parliament and a presidential election followed in August 2025.

wars.name: 2023 Las Anod conflict

zones.text: Las Anod, Sool and the Dhulbahante lands round it ('parts of the Sool, Sanaag and Togdheer regions'), from the Somaliland front at about 100 km west of Las Anod to the Somaliland border; the same 120 km disc as the somaliland ledger (4 and 5), cut to Somaliland

wars.outcome: 6 February to 28 August 2023: SSC-Khatumo captured the Maraaga and Goojacade bases and the towns of Las Anod district and Sool; the Somaliland army withdrew about 100 km west of Las Anod; the Federal Government of Somalia recognised SSC-Khatumo on 19 October 2023 and the fighting spilled over into Togdheer and Sanaag.
wars.note: The front line stood about 100 km west of Las Anod in August 2024, a stalemate; fighting at Qoorlugud (Buuhoodle) on 31 October and 1 November 2024, both sides claiming victory. The somaliland dossier lists the same war as 'Las Anod conflict'.

certainty.note: A military front between Oog and Guumays, a stalemate since the autumn of 2023; no treaty or survey line, so the edge is soft.

notes: Written by n-mod from two pages. REBEL STATE (secessionist from Somaliland, since 19 October 2023 an interim federal administration of Somalia and since 30 July 2025 the North Eastern State of Somalia): the same entity throughout, so one dossier and a rename. NEIGHBOUR: somaliland ledger 4 (contest_start) and 5 (loss) name this slug with year only and the 120 km disc; their pairing contest_end for ssc-khatumo is missing in the somaliland dossier (this dossier carries the 28 August 2023 end). FEDERAL STATUS: no vassal_start exists in the federal-republic-of-somalia ledger for this state; whether the compile draws it as a Somali tint is open. The Khatumo State of 12 January 2012 and the SSC of 2009 held no ground on the pages opened and are not drawn; Puntland's 2025 fighting at Dhahar and Khatumo's capture of Shahda (24 May 2025) are on the SSC page without boundaries. Buuhoodle (Cayn) is not placed (gazetteer lacks it). The somaliland ledger 4/5 text says 'parts of the Sool, Sanaag and Togdheer regions'; the pages opened name Sool and Las Anod district as held and Togdheer and Sanaag only as places the fighting spilled into. End 2026 = alive today.
